app.name: Treatable
app.purpose: Treatable helps you find public clinical studies and prepare questions to ask a study team.
disclaimer.matchingLimits: Matching does not establish eligibility, safety, or benefit.
disclaimer.scoreMeaning: A match score is not a probability of eligibility, enrollment, or treatment benefit.
disclaimer.distance: Distance preferences are not medical exclusions.
disclaimer.unknownEligibility: Eligibility information that is not known stays marked unknown. Only the study team can confirm eligibility.
disclaimer.participationDraftOnly: Participation help is limited to drafts that you review. Treatable does not submit applications, email researchers, enroll you in a study, complete clinical screening, or sign consent for you.
disclaimer.publicRecords: Study records come from the public ClinicalTrials.gov registry and can be out of date. Confirm recruitment status, eligibility, and locations with the study team.
disclaimer.notClinicallyValidated: Treatable has not been clinically validated. It does not diagnose conditions or recommend treatment.
disclaimer.notAnonymous: Minimized health information is not anonymous.
disclaimer.notPhiReady: Not PHI-ready by default. Treatable has not confirmed whether a business associate agreement (BAA) or data retention terms cover your OpenAI account, and it does not verify a BAA.
disclaimer.noComplianceClaim: Treatable makes no claim of HIPAA compliance or legal sufficiency.
operator.label: Operator
operator.name: Kurt Lehnardt - Developer of Treatable
operator.noticeOnly: The operator and privacy contact are shown for your information only. They are never sent to a model.
operator.noRecordLookup: Treatable keeps no identifiers after a session ends, so the operator may be unable to locate a provider record from an earlier session.
disclosure.ctgov.heading: What ClinicalTrials.gov receives
disclosure.ctgov.body: The request that Treatable sends to clinicaltrials.gov over HTTPS includes your search terms, the country (United States), and at most a US state. ClinicalTrials.gov's own policies apply to that request. The request does not include your ZIP code or coordinates, and Treatable calculates distance itself inside the app.
disclosure.ctgov.networkNote: Like any web request, it also reveals your network address to the service.
disclosure.openai.heading: What OpenAI receives
disclosure.openai.body: Only after you confirm: a condition term you selected from public ClinicalTrials.gov vocabulary, your age band, your US state if you chose to share it, your sex entry, and public study fields from ClinicalTrials.gov records.
disclosure.openai.conditionTerm: The condition term comes from public ClinicalTrials.gov vocabulary, such as condition and MeSH terms on returned study records. It is never text that you typed.
disclosure.openai.neverSent: OpenAI never receives free-text symptoms or notes, ZIP codes, coordinates, exact age, date of birth, names, or contact details.
disclosure.openai.studyContacts: Study contact details are shown to you in the app but are never sent to OpenAI.
disclosure.separation: ClinicalTrials.gov and OpenAI receive different information. Searching does not send anything to OpenAI.
disclosure.agentsRetention: The OpenAI Agents API retains session state and is not compatible with Zero Data Retention. After an analysis, Treatable attempts to cancel any running work and delete the session, and it reports any failure. Treatable does not promise instant physical erasure.
disclosure.decisionsRetention: Treatable has not confirmed how long OpenAI retains data sent to the Decisions API. Read OpenAI's current data controls documentation before you confirm a request.
disclosure.cannotRetract: Ending a session cannot take back data that was already sent to ClinicalTrials.gov or OpenAI.
disclosure.credentials: OpenAI features use your own OpenAI API key, which Treatable stores only in your operating system's credential store. There is no plaintext fallback. Without a stored key, OpenAI features stay locked.
disclosure.limits: Treatable cannot protect against a compromised operating system, privileged debuggers, or memory forensics.
notice.title: Privacy and health-data notice
notice.regionLabel: Privacy and health-data notice. Scroll to the end to continue.
notice.scrollHint: Scroll to the end of this notice to enable the acknowledgment.
notice.acknowledgmentLabel: I have read this notice and I understand the health-data disclosure and the provider retention described above.
notice.acknowledgmentSessionOnly: This acknowledgment lasts only for the current session and is not saved.
notice.section.01.heading: Your choice
notice.section.01.body: Searching ClinicalTrials.gov and screening results inside the app work without OpenAI. OpenAI analysis is optional. It starts only after you read this notice, acknowledge it, review the exact request that would be sent, and confirm sending as a separate step. If you decline, you can keep searching and screening.
notice.section.02.heading: What ClinicalTrials.gov receives
notice.section.02.body: The request that Treatable sends to clinicaltrials.gov over HTTPS includes your search terms, the country (United States), and at most a US state. ClinicalTrials.gov's own policies apply to that request. The request does not include your ZIP code or coordinates, and Treatable calculates distance itself inside the app. Like any web request, it also reveals your network address to the service. Searching does not send anything to OpenAI.
notice.section.03.heading: What OpenAI receives
notice.section.03.body: Only after you confirm: a condition term you selected from public ClinicalTrials.gov vocabulary, your age band, your US state if you chose to share it, your sex entry, and public study fields from ClinicalTrials.gov records. The condition term comes from public ClinicalTrials.gov vocabulary, such as condition and MeSH terms on returned study records. It is never text that you typed. OpenAI never receives free-text symptoms or notes, ZIP codes, coordinates, exact age, date of birth, names, or contact details. Study contact details are shown to you in the app but are never sent to OpenAI.
notice.section.04.heading: Minimized is not anonymous
notice.section.04.body: A condition term, an age band, and a US state can still identify a person when they are combined. Minimized health information is not anonymous. Not PHI-ready by default. Treatable has not confirmed whether a business associate agreement (BAA) or data retention terms cover your OpenAI account, and it does not verify a BAA. Treatable makes no claim of HIPAA compliance or legal sufficiency.
notice.section.05.heading: OpenAI Agents retention
notice.section.05.body: The OpenAI Agents API retains session state and is not compatible with Zero Data Retention. After an analysis, Treatable attempts to cancel any running work and delete the session, and it reports any failure. Treatable does not promise instant physical erasure. Ending a session cannot take back data that was already sent to ClinicalTrials.gov or OpenAI.
notice.section.06.heading: OpenAI Decisions retention
notice.section.06.body: Treatable has not confirmed how long OpenAI retains data sent to the Decisions API. Read OpenAI's current data controls documentation before you confirm a request.
notice.section.07.heading: Your OpenAI API key
notice.section.07.body: OpenAI features use your own OpenAI API key, which Treatable stores only in your operating system's credential store. There is no plaintext fallback. Without a stored key, OpenAI features stay locked. Treatable never asks for your key in chat and contains no shared OpenAI key.
notice.section.08.heading: Session-only handling
notice.section.08.body: Treatable has no saved profiles, notes, search history, analytics, or crash reporting. Your entries, results, request previews, and trace exist only in memory during the current session. Ending the session clears them and cancels work in progress. Any cache of public study records is kept separate from your entries, is labeled as public study data, and shows when each record was retrieved.
notice.section.09.heading: Limits of these controls
notice.section.09.body: Treatable cannot protect against a compromised operating system, privileged debuggers, or memory forensics. Data held in system memory, crash dumps, or files outside the control of the app can remain after a session ends.
notice.section.10.heading: Before anything is sent
notice.section.10.body: Before anything is sent to OpenAI, you review the exact request bodies and public tool results in a preview, and then you confirm sending as a separate step. A prepared request expires after five minutes and can be used once. Changing any entry discards the preview and your confirmation. Stopping a request asks for cancellation and cleanup, but Treatable cannot promise that OpenAI has erased the data.
notice.section.11.heading: What results mean
notice.section.11.body: Research information, not medical advice. A match score is not a probability of eligibility, enrollment, or treatment benefit. Distance preferences are not medical exclusions. Eligibility information that is not known stays marked unknown. Only the study team can confirm eligibility. Participation help is limited to drafts that you review. Treatable does not submit applications, email researchers, enroll you in a study, complete clinical screening, or sign consent for you.
notice.section.12.heading: Operator and privacy contact
notice.section.12.body: Operator: Kurt Lehnardt - Developer of Treatable. Privacy contact: privacy.6vpc5@mailer.me. The operator and privacy contact are shown for your information only. They are never sent to a model. Treatable keeps no identifiers after a session ends, so the operator may be unable to locate a provider record from an earlier session.
consent.separateConfirmationNote: Acknowledging the notice does not send anything. Sending needs a separate confirmation of the exact request.
consent.prepareButton: Prepare exact request preview (no OpenAI call)
consent.previewExplanation: This preview shows the complete request bodies and the public tool results that would be sent to OpenAI. It contains the health information you selected. Preparing a preview does not contact OpenAI.
consent.previewNoCredentials: Your API key is not part of the preview and is never shown.
consent.expiryNote: A prepared request expires after five minutes and can be used once.
consent.invalidationNote: Changing any entry discards the preview and your confirmation.
consent.confirmLabel: I reviewed this exact request and I confirm sending it to OpenAI for the operation I choose below.
consent.oneUseNote: Each operation can be sent once per prepared request.
payload.heading: What you choose to share with OpenAI
payload.notSharedNote: Free-text notes, ZIP code, coordinates, exact age, date of birth, names, and contact details are not part of this request.
credential.heading: Your OpenAI API key
credential.explanation: Treatable uses your own OpenAI API key. It is stored only in your operating system's credential store.
credential.lockedWithoutKey: OpenAI features stay locked until a key is available in the credential store.
credential.prompt: Enter your OpenAI API key. Treatable stores it only in your operating system's credential store.
credential.neverInChat: Never share your key in chat or in a message.
credential.noSharedKey: Treatable contains no shared OpenAI key.
credential.removeConfirm: Remove your OpenAI API key from the credential store? OpenAI features will be locked until you add a key again.
credential.statusPresent: A key is stored in the credential store.
credential.statusLocked: The credential store is locked or unavailable.
credential.keepsAfterSession: Ending a session does not remove your key from the credential store.
error.networkOffline: You appear to be offline. Search and OpenAI analysis need a network connection. Anything already on screen is kept.
error.ctgovUnavailable: ClinicalTrials.gov did not respond or is unavailable. Try again in a moment.
error.ctgovRateLimited: ClinicalTrials.gov is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.openaiUnavailable: OpenAI is unavailable or returned an error. Your local results are kept. Check the trace to see what was sent and whether cleanup finished.
error.consentRequired: Acknowledge the notice, review the exact request preview, and confirm sending before anything is sent to OpenAI.
error.consentExpired: The prepared request expired after five minutes. Prepare a new preview and confirm it again.
error.consentInvalidated: You changed an entry, so the preview and your confirmation were discarded. Prepare a new preview and confirm it again.
error.consentUsed: This prepared request was already used. Prepare a new preview to run another operation.
error.credentialMissing: No OpenAI API key is stored. OpenAI features stay locked. Add your key to continue.
error.credentialLocked: The operating system's credential store is locked or unavailable. OpenAI features stay locked. Unlock it and try again.
error.cancelled: Cancelled. Cleanup of any OpenAI session was attempted. Check the trace for the result. Your local results are kept.
error.deletionFailed: Deletion of the OpenAI session failed or could not be confirmed. Provider data may remain. Treatable keeps no identifiers after you end the session, so the operator may be unable to locate the record later.
error.deletionNotAttempted: The OpenAI session could not be identified, so deletion could not be attempted. Provider data may remain.
error.requestTooLarge: The request is larger than the allowed size and was not sent. Choose fewer items and prepare the preview again.
error.invalidInput: Some entries are not valid. Check the entries and try again.
error.preparationFailed: Preparation failed. Nothing was sent to OpenAI.
error.analysisIncomplete: The analysis did not complete. Provider data may remain. Check the cleanup status in the trace. Your local results are kept.
error.componentUnavailable: Treatable's search and analysis component is not responding. End the session and start a new one.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Your local results are kept.
trace.heading: Session-only trace
trace.explanation: This trace exists only in memory during the current session. It is never saved as history. Ending the session clears it, but that cannot take back data that was already sent.
trace.mode.mockedNote: Mocked: a test adapter produced this result and no request reached OpenAI.
trace.mode.liveNote: Live: this result comes from a validated response from the OpenAI API.
trace.cleanupStatus.deleted: Deletion acknowledged by OpenAI. Physical removal can happen later.
trace.cleanupStatus.failed: Deletion failed. Provider data may remain.
trace.cleanupStatus.unconfirmed: Deletion could not be attempted or confirmed.
session.endDescription: Ending the session clears your entries, results, request previews, and trace from memory, cancels work in progress, and requests deletion of any OpenAI session.
session.endCleared: Cleared: your entries, the notice acknowledgment, prepared requests and confirmations, results, and the trace.
session.endNotCleared: Not cleared: data already sent to ClinicalTrials.gov or OpenAI, your API key in the credential store, and anything outside the control of the app, such as system memory or crash dumps.
session.endDone: Session ended. The app is blank.
session.nothingSaved: Nothing you enter is saved. Treatable has no saved profiles, notes, or history.
cache.label: Public study data cache
cache.description: This cache is kept separate from anything you enter. It holds only public ClinicalTrials.gov study records, and each record shows when it was retrieved.
cache.staleWarning: Cached public study data can be out of date. Check the source record on ClinicalTrials.gov.
